TENANT ESTOPPEL CERTIFICATE

To: Cordelia Bank, National Association, and its successors and assigns ("Lender")
And to: Fennimore Yards Owner LLC ("Landlord")

Re: Lease dated September 14, 2021 between Fennimore Yards Owner LLC, as landlord, and Brightwater Analytics, Inc., as tenant, for Suite 700, 88 Fennimore Yards, Rochester, New York

The undersigned, Brightwater Analytics, Inc. ("Tenant"), certifies to Lender and Landlord as of the date below:

1. The Lease. The Lease described above is in full force and effect. A true and complete copy, including all amendments, is attached as Exhibit A. The Lease has been amended only by the First Amendment to Lease dated June 2, 2023 and the Second Amendment to Lease dated March 11, 2025.

2. Premises and Term. Tenant occupies Suite 700, containing approximately 24,180 rentable square feet. The term commenced on January 1, 2022 and expires on December 31, 2031. Tenant has two options to extend the term, each for five years, exercisable not later than twelve months before the then-current expiration date.

3. Rent. Current monthly base rent is $84,630.00, paid through the month in which this certificate is dated. Tenant's proportionate share of operating expenses and real estate taxes is 11.4%. No rent has been prepaid more than one month in advance.

4. Security. Landlord holds a letter of credit in the face amount of $507,780.00 as security. No cash security deposit is held.

5. Landlord Obligations. To Tenant's knowledge, Landlord is not in default under the Lease, and no event has occurred that with notice or the passage of time would become a default. Landlord has completed all improvements it is obligated to construct and has paid all allowances it is obligated to pay.

6. Tenant Obligations. Tenant is not in default under the Lease. Tenant has accepted and is in possession of the Premises.

7. No Offsets. Tenant has no claim, offset, defense, or counterclaim against Landlord under the Lease, and no right to any free rent, abatement, or concession that has not already been applied.

8. No Assignment. Tenant has not assigned the Lease or sublet any part of the Premises, and has not granted any lien or security interest in the leasehold.

9. No Purchase Rights. Tenant has no right of first refusal, right of first offer, option to purchase, or other right to acquire the Premises or the building.

10. Reliance. Tenant acknowledges that Lender will rely on this certificate in making a loan secured by the property, that Landlord will rely on it, and that their successors and assigns may rely on it. This certificate does not amend the Lease, and in the event of a conflict the Lease controls except that Tenant is estopped from asserting a fact contrary to a statement made here.

11. Notices. Tenant's address for notices is Suite 700, 88 Fennimore Yards, Rochester, New York 14620, Attention: General Counsel.

Dated: May 19, 2026

BRIGHTWATER ANALYTICS, INC.

By: /s/ Anneliese Vandergriff
Name: Anneliese Vandergriff
Title: Chief Financial Officer
